title: Yaa Asantewaa and the War of the Golden Stool
summary: When British governor Hodgson demanded the sacred Golden Stool, Queen Mother Yaa Asantewaa raised a force against the British. Britain won and exiled her to the Seychelles, but the Asante kept the Stool hidden.
why: A woman-led war over a sacred symbol; the Stool was never handed over.
